tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Which is cheaper, the bus or the taxi?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Which is cheaper, the bus or the train?" (You make the adjective comparative.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue tile is an adjective in its base form. Make it comparative (cheap → cheaper) or superlative after the (tall → the tallest). Long adjectives take more: more expensive.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Short word: -er. Long word: more. Cheap – cheaper, expensive – more expensive.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
